# Sailing — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where did Sailing originate?", "Netherlands/England"),
    ("How is Sailing scored?", "lowest points series"),
    ("What is origin?", "Netherlands/England, 1900 (Olympic)"),
    ("What is players?", "crew"),
    ("What is equipment?", "sailboat"),
    ("What is venue?", "open water"),
    ("What is scoring?", "lowest points series"),
    ("What is governing body?", "World Sailing"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
